systems.platform: solar power, computing equipment and telemedicine by camera-equipped smart glasses
systems.owner: UNDP with WHO, the Ministère de la Santé et du Développement social, the Université de Sherbrooke and the Agence des Énergies Renouvelables; financed by AECID and UN funds
systems.tiers: 34 health structures to December 2025: 27 CSCOM and 7 Centres de Santé de Référence in Kayes, Koulikoro, Sikasso, Ségou, Mopti, Bandiagara and Bamako district; CHU Gabriel Touré also

systems.system: electronic billing and cash-tracking software, CSCOM de Kalaké
systems.country_label: système électronique de facturation / logiciel de gestion financière
systems.owner: CSCOM de Kalaké, under the SanDi project

note: UNDP story of 26 December 2025: power, devices and telemedicine (enabling) and a billing system that replaced handwritten tickets, which is administration only and out of scope; nothing on routine reporting or a patient record.
